verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says private connections are live from the moment you deploy. That implies zero-config internal networking with no VPC setup, but it rests on a single one-line claim with no detail. The Railway Agent can also 'wire up networking', which is adjacent support. missing for 10: documentation of how private networking works (internal DNS/hostnames, isolation guarantees that service-to-service traffic never traverses the public internet), configuration or limits details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity

citations.quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
Create services, set variables, connect databases, wire up networking, and adjust resource limits.
